source.reason: GW's guide gives the Runtherd of a Gretchin unit a 32mm base. In these lists the Gretchin units have no Runtherd model (New Recruit: "10x Gretchin"): the Runtherd is a datasheet of its own that supports Gretchin (ooga-booga's Zodgrod Wortsnagga + Runtherd + Gretchin unit, on 32mm, matched to this row).
